thread:
SRE-Bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT (sev2) — spike in 5xx + latency across inference-prod (us-west-2). Paging #eng-oncall. runbook: https://internal/runbooks/inference/5xx-spike

Alex W: I'm on initial triage. Seeing request queue depth jump on the autoscale metrics (queue_depth_per_shard). Paging Mira for GPU pool health.

Mira C: ACK. Checking GPU pools now. `gcloud compute ssh gpu-pool-manager --tail /var/log/pool-agent.log` — seeing repeated warmup failures at ~2051235700-2051236000. Possible warmup latency.

Jon R: Customer-facing note: a few customers reported elevated latency and transient 502s starting ~2051235600. No full region outage yet.

Sam P: I can run a quick HPA check. Running: `kubectl get hpa -n inference --no-headers` — current targets: cpu:80% (scale up threshold), custom/queue_depth:100. HPA not firing aggressively because short spikes under cooldown.

Liz H: Also saw GPU pool reported nodeNotReady events around the same time — kubelet OOM kills on warmup init containers. Logs show `OOMKilled` for warmup init at timestamps matching warmup failures.

Alex W: Hypothesis 1: warmup init containers failing -> missed cache population -> many cold requests -> queue depth spikes -> HPA can't react quick enough due to cooldown and metric smoothing -> GPU pool saturates -> tail latencies and 5xx.

Mira C: Hypothesis 2: routing fallback sent inference-calls to smaller model variants with different startup patterns causing additional memory pressure. Checking routing logs.

Ops-Bot: Deploy-bot: New deployment inference-runtime:v2.14 rolled at 2051235400 in us-west-2. No automatic rollback.

Jon R: Correlate deploy time and warmup fails — that release touched warmup initimage. Could be a regression.

Sam P: Live mitigations proposed: 1) increase HPA maxReplicas by +50% for the region 2) temporarily lower HPA cooldown to 30s 3) manually scale GPU pool (add 4 nodes) 4) revert v2.14 if we confirm warmup regression. Which to do first?

Alex W: Do (3) and (1) first to buy time. I'll trigger manual GPU pool scale and bump HPA max.

Mira C: Manual GPU pool scale in progress: `cloudctl pools scale inference-gpu-usw2 --add 4` — started at 2051236105. ETA ~4m.

Liz H: Meanwhile I'm collecting warmup init logs and kubelet events to the RCA bucket: `/var/tmp/rca/2051236789_warmup_logs.tgz` — uploading now.

Alex W: Bumped HPA maxReplicas: `kubectl patch hpa inference -n inference -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":60}}'` at 2051236168. Lowered stabilizationWindow to 30s.

SRE-Bot: Auto-alert: queue_depth_per_shard returned to baseline after nodes started coming up. 5xx rate trending down.

Mira C: GPU nodes added and passing healthchecks at 2051236390. Warmup success rate increased but still seeing occasional init container mem spikes.

Jon R: Customer impact: ~12 customers experienced elevated latencies / transient errors. Not a data-loss incident. Sending notifications to affected customers with status update.

Sam P: Captured relevant HPA metrics and pod events window: `metrics-server` snapshots + `kubectl get events -n inference --since=40m` — saved to `/tmp/hpa_events_2051236789.log`.

Alex W: Next steps for in-incident RCA coordination: 1) collect logs + diffs between v2.13 and v2.14 warmup image 2) run replay of warmup containers in staging with same mem limits 3) evaluate making warmup optional for now / revert if regression confirmed.

Liz H: I've uploaded `warmup_init_dumps/2051236789/` to the RCA share (links sent in thread DM). Also attached `kubelet-oom-20512358.log` snippet.

--- log snippet ---
```
I0325 20:35:12 kubelet: pod "warmup-init-xyz" root cause: container killed (OOMKilled) usage=1.9G limit=2G
I0325 20:35:13 warmup-init: retrying init job, attempt=3
I0325 20:35:19 warmup-init: success, cache populated
```
--- end log snippet ---

Mira C: Noting that some inits succeeded after retrying, which explains partial recovery but suggests insufficient mem headroom. We should review init container mem requests/limits.

Jon R: Hypothesis 3: host-level memory pressure from other daemons during burst (e.g., new monitoring agent from v2.14) caused less headroom for init containers. Need to diff node images/agents.

Sam P: For the short term, recommend increasing warmup init memory request by +256Mi and increasing pool node size if needed. For long term: make warmup idempotent and backoff-friendly, add warmup health metric to HPA signal.

Alex W: I've kicked off a rollback PR draft for v2.14 -> v2.13 for warmup image only. If tests fail or rollback blocked, we'll prefer warmup config change.

Ops-Bot: Incident timer: started 00:00:00 at 2051236789. Current incident age ~00:45.

SRE-Bot: Incident update: Degraded -> Stabilizing. 5xx rate back to baseline; queue depth normal. Marking page resolved but keeping thread open for RCA notes.

Liz H: Action items assigned in thread: 
- Alex W: confirm rollback or warmup config change and post diff (due 2051240400)
- Mira C: run node image diff and report if additional agents were introduced (due 2051240000)
- Sam P: propose HPA change to include queue_depth smoothing tune + playbook update (due 2051242000)
- Jon R: customer incident notices + timeline (due 2051239200)

Alex W: I'll post logs and the exact `kubectl` commands used in the revert or config patch once PR created.

Mira C: For the RCA document: capturing timeline, hypothesis, logs, mitigations applied, and follow-ups. Creating initial doc at `/docs/incidents/2051236789-autoscale-warmup-rca.md`.

Jon R: Adding note: consider short-term change to allow HPA to consider max queue growth rate as an immediate scale trigger (spike-aware scaling).

Sam P: Agree. Also add integration test simulating many small cold requests to validate warmup + HPA interactions.

SRE-Bot: Incident closed (page resolved). Please continue in-thread with RCA artifacts. :white_check_mark:
